titles.en: Stele of the Shence Army, unique Song rubbing

dimensions.raw: 27 开、54 页；通高 34.3 厘米，通宽 46 厘米
dimensions.note: Cut-and-mounted album; the lower volume is lost.

currentCollection.note: Held by the National Library of China since its return in 1965.
currentCollection.noteZh: 1965 年购回后入藏中国国家图书馆。

provenanceEvents.placeWording: 北京图书馆（今中国国家图书馆）
provenanceEvents.summary: Bought back from Hong Kong with government funds and deposited in the National Library, together with six other rubbings and books.
provenanceEvents.summaryZh: 经周恩来过问，与另外六种碑帖古籍一同自香港购回，入藏北京图书馆。

review.note: Draft object record. The album is dated only as a Song mounting; the exact rubbing date is not established.
review.noteZh: 草稿记录。此本只定为宋装宋拓，具体拓制年代未定。

notes: Only the upper volume survives; one opening of two pages is missing between pages 42 and 43.
The original stone is lost, so no comparison with the stone is possible.
The source does not give a full plate-by-plate condition report.
notesZh: 仅存上册；第 42 与 43 页之间缺一开二页。
原石已佚，无法与石对校。
来源没有逐页的保存状况说明。
